question: Does a reusable, full-text Palawan freshwater-fish source support a bounded historical species-by-locality projection?

source.title: A new species of the genus Stiphodon from Palawan, Philippines (Gobiidae: Sicydiinae)
source.citation: Maeda, K. & Palla, H. P. (2015). A new species of the genus Stiphodon from Palawan, Philippines (Gobiidae: Sicydiinae). Zootaxa, 4018(3), 381–395. https://doi.org/10.11646/zootaxa.4018.3.3.
source.licenseEvidence: The publisher PDF first page states that the article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution License and links CC BY 3.0.
source.attributionAndChanges: The app projection cites the authors, article, journal, DOI and license. It groups the article's material-examined statements by source locality and omits coordinates, figures and photographs.

extraction.method: Reviewed the publisher-hosted 15-page article, including its Material examined section. Transcribed only the source's taxon name, collection locality, collection date, specimen-group count and voucher catalogue references; no coordinates or map geometry were derived.
extraction.currentTaxonomyCrosscheck: Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes lists the current status as Valid as Stiphodon palawanensis Maeda & Palla 2015 (online version updated 2026-08-13). This confirms nomenclatural status only; it does not independently re-identify the source specimens.

siteGroups.locality: Balsahan Stream in the Iwahig Prison and Penal Farm, Puerto Princesa City, Palawan
Estrella Falls (tributary of Malatgao River), Narra, Palawan
Iwahig River, Puerto Princesa City, Palawan
Barake Stream (tributary of Aborlan River), Barangay Magbabadil, Aborlan, Palawan

siteGroups.disposition: Retained as locality-only research context; the paper does not name a waterbody for this group, so it is not assigned to a stream, river, or lake and is not projected as a waterbody assertion.

projectionDecision.scopeSpecificReuse: One attributed projection of paraphrased locality/date/voucher-count facts under the article's stated CC BY 3.0 license. This is not blanket approval for other content, figures, images, or future extracts from the article.

caveats: This is historical preserved-specimen evidence from collections dated 1985 to 2015, not evidence of current presence, population abundance, catch totals, catchability, fishing access or legal status.
The listed counts are source-reported specimens examined; the article's locality groups are not a standardized survey effort or comparable abundance estimate.
The source names eight aquatic collection features for 48 specimens. It lists nine additional specimens from Tagbariri without naming a waterbody; that group is excluded from waterbody assignments.
The article does not provide coordinates for the projected localities. No point, shoreline, reach, or geometry is inferred.
The current Catalog of Fishes status agrees with the article's name, but it does not independently re-identify these historical vouchers or establish current site presence.
The article's CC BY 3.0 notice supports only the scope-specific attributed projection described here; no figure, image, or article prose is reproduced.

sources.supports: Official publisher metadata, authors, citation, publication date, abstract and 57-specimen summary.
Full article, material-examined locality/date/voucher groups, and first-page CC BY 3.0 notice.
Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes current status entry: valid as Stiphodon palawanensis Maeda & Palla 2015; nomenclature only, not voucher re-identification.
CC BY 3.0 attribution and adaptation terms.

followUp.nextAction: Continue MIMAROPA freshwater source review across Palawan and the other regional provinces. Prioritize lake, river and stream surveys with site-by-taxon and voucher detail; do not treat this single-species paper as regional completion.
